Deine Aufgaben

- Manage the entire product lifecycle of our hardware platforms, PCIe HSMs, appliances, and other form factors, maximizing benefits for the company by collecting requirements, setting strategy, managing implementation, and related technical aspects.
- Collect requirements from sales, customer interactions, professional services, production, and R&D to optimize the platform for various business applications, supporting the highest levels of security.
- Work with your manager, senior executives, and major stakeholders to drive the technical strategy, product roadmap, and related messaging for the hardware platform, bridging the technical and business worlds to significantly accelerate our business.
- Collaborate with partners and customers on a technical level to define and develop the next generation of security hardware, retrieving market feedback, conducting competitive analysis, and defining metrics for informed direction.
- Drive hardware platform planning aligned with product goals and requirements, ensuring ownership of product positioning, considering operational and production requirements, and monitoring successful implementation.
- Partner with senior leadership to identify new business opportunities.

Dein Profil

- Technical and business experience in areas of Hardware Security Modules, embedded systems, cyber security.
- Demonstrated ability to achieve strategic goals in a fast-paced environment, and to evolve product strategy based on customer feedback, research data, and cross-industry trends.
- Ability to plan and manage a portfolio of related features, and to deliver initiatives from conception through completion.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with sound business judgment, proven ability to influence others, and tenacity to develop ideas independently.
- Ability to work effectively across departments, and to meet tight deadlines and prioritize workloads.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, customer understanding, cross-group experience, and enthusiasm, with a strong understanding of technical requirements.
- Excellent English communication skills both written and verbal, further languages are a plus.

Wir bieten

- An open and friendly corporate culture characterized by constructive and collaborative interaction.
- A flexible working hours model that can be adapted to individual needs.
- Personal protection through international travel health insurance, private accident insurance, and support in the form of company pension schemes.
- Professional and personal development through targeted training opportunities.
- Free beverages, fresh fruit, and sweets.
- Participation in sports programs such as running events or back training.

Fühlst Du dich angesprochen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung unter Angabe des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und Gehaltsvorstellung.

Your tasks

- As an experienced Fullstack Developer (all genders), you design and build scalable web applications as well as reusable components for our e-commerce, PIM, and CMS solutions. Occasionally, you'll liaise directly with clients on technical questions
- Depending on the project, you'll work with a modern tech stack including PHP (Symfony), Twig, Node.js, TypeScript, React, Tailwind, and Storybook
- Together with your development team, and in close collaboration with our design and conception colleagues, you continuously improve the user experience
- You build automated deployment solutions, reusable packages, tests, and interfaces to external integrations, driving our technical processes forward
- You value clean, maintainable code and find pragmatic, solution-oriented approaches to technical challenges

Your experience

- You bring experience in developing and maintaining web applications as well as component-based frontend development. You enjoy occasional client interaction
- You have several years of experience with a modern tech stack such as Node.js, TypeScript, React, Docker, and GraphQL, and are confident working with PHP and PHP-based frameworks like Symfony
- Solid knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL, along with confident use of Git, form the foundation of your work
- You're comfortable with CSS frameworks like Tailwind, templating languages like Twig, and building reusable UI components
- You're solution-oriented, reliable, and a strong team player, with very good English skills

Our benefits

Our employees should feel comfortable all the time. That's why we try to make the working environment as pleasant as possible.

- Mental Health: To support the mental health of our colleagues, we offer anonymous, free access to webinars and group sessions as well as individual consultations with coaches, psychologists or psychotherapists via the platform Nilo. Mental health is not a luxury, but the cornerstone of our happiness.
- Workation: valantic DXA offers you the possibility to use your mobile work quota also Europe-wide. For example, you can extend your vacation and your vacation feeling.
- Modern working environment: No matter where our employees work - at one of our 4 locations, in the home office or on the road - we attach great importance to the best hardware and a modern working environment. Our offices are equipped with the latest technology and we offer the support of an external service provider for home office equipment.
- Locations: If you want to manage modern projects, you can't squat in the last hole! All our offices are equipped with the latest technology and reflect the flair of the location.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Join the dynamic Internal Consulting team at Boehringer Ingelheim! We're looking for innovative thinkers who are ready to shape our company's future.
As a Manager Consulting, you'll design, execute, and steer strategic initiatives within Boehringer Ingelheim. You'll independently coordinate project tasks, run data analyses, develop hypotheses and strategize solutions.
We value work-life balance, offering flexible work models and a location at the Headquarters in the Frankfurt Rhine-Main area.
This position is part time eligible with min. 80%.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As Manager Consulting, you will support in the design, execution and steering of strategic initiatives across businesses, functions, therapeutic areas, and regions within Boehringer Ingelheim.
- You will independently drive work packages within projects, generating strategic insights to enable informed decisions of top-level leaders.
- With your experience, you will run data analyses, develop hypotheses, find possible strategic paths and create actionable solutions to advance the organization.
- Having the successful outcome always in mind, you will track the progress and strategic alignment of projects and initiatives, in close collaboration with our business partners.

Requirements

- Excellent master's degree in sciences, economics or engineering (PhD or MBA a plus)
- Several years' experience with top-tier management consultancy, preferably with a focus on Pharma
- Track record of working on diverse national and international strategic projects
- Excellent critical thinking and analytical skills, with high attention to detail
- Great team player, with strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills
- C1 level English (written and verbal); additional languages are a plus

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until August 21st, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to August 07th, 2026 are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting
Step 3: On-site interviews
Please submit your application documents in English.

jobs.occupation: R&D Scientist Virology* (Facharzt/-ärztin - Mikrobiologie, Virologie und Infektionsepidemiologie)
jobs.description:
Your missionResponsibilities
• Design, plan, and execute research activities within early and advanced projects, e.g analysis and interpretation of data to support target validation and candidate profiling – including benchwork as needed
• Provide guidance and functional leadership to technicians, including supervision of experimental work
• Identify scientific challenges and propose solutions or alternative approaches
• Integrate internal and external data (e.g. literature, databases, experimental results) to generate insights supporting project decisions
• Initiate and coordinate research collaborations with academic partners, CROs, and external experts
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (e.g. research, clinical, regulatory) to ensure alignment of activities with project goals
• Contribute to the evaluation of external opportunities, including participation in due diligence activities
• Support resource planning and coordination of activities within assigned projects
• Present data in internal and external meetings and conferences as a speaker and representative of AiCuris
• Prepare and contribute to scientific documents, including research reports, publications, patents, and regulatory documents

Your profileSkills and Qualification
• Education : PhD in (Molecular) Virology or a related discipline, with at least 2 years of experience in antiviral research and/or drug discovery within an academic or industry-based virology laboratory
• In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with virology laboratory methods and technologies
• Ability to design and conduct experiments to address project relevant questions based on relevant scientific and patent literature
• Hands-on experience relevant state of the art scientific software, including sequence analysis and scientific data analysis software, such as Geneious Prime and GraphPad Prism, or comparable tools
• Strong commitment to scientific rigor, data integrity, and thorough documentation of experimental work
• Proven ability to independently manage research projects and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams, while providing scientific guidance, mentoring, and technical support to laboratory staff
• Willingness to learn and apply regulatory (GCP/GLP/GMP, FDA/EMA regulations) and quality assurance (QA) requirements into work practices as needed.
• Soft Skills: Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex tasks. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Very good communication skills with the ability to present complex data clearly. Collaborative team player with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset. High level of personal motivation and ownership
• Languages: Excellent written and verbal English; in addition, German language skills (at least B1 level) are considered essential, as the role involves regular interaction with technicians who may prefer communication in German.

Why us?What we offer
• Unique corporate culture: Scientific excellence, a collaborative working environment and the passion to improve the lives of patients defines our work. With us, you can work together with innovation awarded experts with the proven ability to translate science into commercial success. You can expect diversity, inspiration as well as trustful collaboration.
• Development: We encourage people to grow and strongly support individual development and learning opportunities.
• Flexibility: Embracing flexible working accommodations, we enable our people to integrate business into their personal life.
• Benefits: Employer-funded pension comes along with an attractive benefits package

About usAiCuris is meeting the needs of the growing population of immunocompromised people who require precise therapies to effectively treat infection. Our flagship product, PREVYMIS, marketed by our partner MSD, treats CMV in a defined group of transplant recipients. Our pivotal phase 3 candidate Pritelivir aims to address recurrent and resistant HSV infections in a broad population of patients with weakened immune systems. For immunocompromised people, an otherwise manageable infection can mean life or death. AiCuris, with its expertise and growing pipeline, is committed to providing therapeutic solutions for them now and in the future.We believe in a culture of trust and transparency, where feedback is considered an opportunity to contribute to each other's personal and professional growth. We hire people who are collaborative, adaptable, communicate well, and love to learn.
*AiCuris is an employer that supports equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people regardless of their national origin, skin color, religion, gender, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or other legally protected characteristics.

The German Diabetes Center (DDZ), Leibniz Institute for Diabetes Research at Heinrich Heine University (HHU) Düsseldorf is an interdisciplinary research institute that integrates basic, translational and clinical research to improve the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of diabetes mellitus and its complications. The Institute for Clinical Biochemistry and Pathobiochemistry (Director: Prof. Dr. Hadi Al-Hasani) investigates the molecular mechanisms underlying insulin resistance, skeletal muscle metabolism and type 2 diabetes.

For a new research project, we are looking for a talented and highly motivated

Doctoral Student (PhD / Dr. rer. nat., m/f/div., E13 TV-L 65%)

to join our interdisciplinary research team investigating the molecular mechanisms by which repeated
cold exposure improves skeletal muscle insulin sensitivity.

Insulin resistance of skeletal muscle is a key feature in the development of type 2 diabetes, accounting for the majority of impaired postprandial glucose disposal. While lifestyle interventions such as exercise are well established, repeated cold exposure has recently emerged as a promising strategy to improve insulin sensitivity in humans, with reported improvements of up to 40%. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying these beneficial metabolic adaptations remain largely unknown.

The project aims to identify the signaling pathways responsible for cold-induced improvements in skeletal muscle insulin action. A particular focus will be placed on testing the hypothesis that mild cold-induced muscle activation ("micro-shivering"), rather than brown adipose tissue activation, mediates these metabolic benefits.

The project combines translational human studies with mechanistic investigations in mouse models and offers extensive training in state-of-the-art metabolic and molecular research techniques.
Proteomic analysis of human skeletal muscle biopsies obtained from cold acclimation studies to identify molecular signatures associated with improved insulin sensitivity.
Mechanistic studies in wild-type and UCP1-deficient mice to investigate the effects of cold exposure and muscle activation on glucose uptake and insulin action.
Functional characterization of established and novel regulators of skeletal muscle metabolism, including AMPK, GLUT4, Rac1 and newly identified candidate proteins.
Investigation of GLUT4 trafficking and insulin signaling using advanced molecular and cellular approaches.

The project offers training in:

Mass spectrometry-based proteomics
Mouse models of insulin resistance and metabolic disease
Indirect calorimetry and metabolic phenotyping
Glucose uptake assays in isolated skeletal muscle
Molecular biology techniques (Western blotting, qPCR, gene expression analyses)
Immunohistochemistry and skeletal muscle fibre typing

In vivo electroporation and functional gene manipulation
Fluorescence-based analysis of GLUT4 translocation

You hold (or are close to obtaining) a Master's degree in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Molecular Medicine, Physiology, Biomedical Sciences or a related discipline.
You have practical experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques such as Western blotting, qPCR and cell culture.
Experience with metabolic phenotyping, skeletal muscle biology, mouse models or proteomics is advantageous but not required.
You enjoy interdisciplinary research and are interested in combining human physiology with mechanistic laboratory studies.
You are highly motivated, curious, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment.
You have an excellent command of written and spoken English.

The Faculty of Process and Systems Engineering, Chair of Mechanical Process Engineering seeks to fill the following vacancy:

Junior Group Leader (m/f/d) in Computational Multiphase Flow

13 TV-L

At the Chair of Mechanical Process Engineering (www.mvt.ovgu.de), we are a group of enthusiastic researchers with extensive research activities in the numerical modelling of multiphase flows. Our work addresses the fundamental physical mechanisms governing dispersed and interfacial multiphase flows, as well as their application to engineering systems. Current research topics include particle-laden and droplet-laden turbulent flows, particle–turbulence and droplet–turbulence interactions, the dynamics of non-spherical particles, interfacial flows, and compressible and incompressible multiphase-flow applications. Approximately eight PhD researchers and three postdoctoral researchers currently work in this area at the Chair.

The objective of the advertised position is to attract a junior group leader who will take a leading role in our computational multiphase-flow research. The successful candidate will contribute to and help coordinate ongoing research projects, while also establishing their own research direction within the Chair. The position offers excellent opportunities to develop an independent academic profile and to pursue a Habilitation. It therefore combines scientific leadership in existing activities with the opportunity to initiate new research topics and contribute to the further development of our numerical methods and simulation tools.

Our in-house simulation framework includes state-of-the-art methods for immersed boundaries, Lagrangian particle and droplet tracking, non-spherical particle dynamics, particle and droplet interactions, gas–liquid interfaces, large-eddy simulation, and fully coupled solvers for compressible and incompressible flows. You will also have the opportunity to establish your own teaching portfolio in areas such as numerical methods, multiphase flows, or particle technology.

*The position is full time for a period of 3 years with the opportunity to extend by a further 3 years.

Job description:

- Develop, implement, and analyse analytical and numerical models for multiphase flows
- Establish an independent research profile in computational multiphase-flow modelling
- Lead and coordinate the further development of our in-house simulation tools in C and MPI
- Develop research ideas and prepare proposals for externally funded research projects
- Supervise PhD researchers, postdoctoral researchers, and students working in computational multiphase flows
- Contribute to teaching in multiphase flows, numerical methods, particle technology, or related subjects
- Contribute to the scientific development and coordination of the computational multiphase-flow group
- Opportunity for further scientific qualification, including the possibility to pursue a Habilitation

Requirements profile:

- A Master’s degree or equivalent and a PhD in mechanical engineering, process engineering, aerospace engineering, applied mathematics, physics, or a related discipline
- A strong background in the physical and numerical modelling of fluid-mechanical or multiphase-flow problems
- Demonstrated research experience in computational multiphase flows, such as particle-laden, droplet-laden, or interfacial flows
- Strong scientific-programming skills in C, C++, or Fortran, including experience with MPI and high-performance computing
- Experience in developing numerical methods or simulation software; expertise in techniques such as immersed-boundary methods, Lagrangian tracking, interface-capturing methods, or particle-interaction models is desirable
- A strong publication record commensurate with your career stage, together with the ability to develop independent research ideas and contribute to research proposals
- Excellent written and spoken English, as well as a good command of German or a commitment to acquiring sufficient German proficiency for teaching and administrative duties within two years

For further information about the position, please contact Prof. Berend van Wachem by email, berend.vanwachem(at)ovgu.de
